model_contract.call_wall: strike with maximum aggregated positive Call GEX
model_contract.expected_move: nearest-expiry ATM-near call mid + put mid; never VIX-derived
model_contract.gamma: Black-Scholes gamma from chain impliedVolatility, observed short Treasury rate, q=0
model_contract.gamma_flip: aggregate GEX zero crossing on spot grid; linear interpolation; nearest valid crossing to spot
model_contract.put_wall: strike with minimum signed Put GEX

ordering: Data quality then total OI; not a directional ranking because legacy Direction/Confidence producer is unrecovered.

resilience.note: Only same-session measured option rows are reused; prior-session rows are never promoted as current data.

target_policy.method: Union of the top 50 stocks by 21-, 63-, and 189-completed-session total return among current active-universe stocks with price >= $5 and DDV20 >= $10M; 21-session return uses the same current-session OHLCV already acquired by the production stock pipeline

checks: Spot > Gamma Flip when Gamma Flip is available
aggregate Call GEX > absolute Put GEX
upward_ranking_contract.definition: Observed positioning geometry only; not a forecast or legacy Direction/Confidence replacement.
upward_ranking_contract.ordering: positive check count, observed-check ratio, Call/Put GEX ratio, total OI, ticker
upward_ranking_contract.qualification: At least 3 observed checks and at least 3 positive checks; an observed Spot<=Gamma Flip disqualifies.
